Commander of Izu Base, <Earth Fed Army>.
Mild-mannered, easygoing. A small, gentle old man, seemingly laid-back, once famed as a brilliant tactician on the Joint Chiefs.
P_0x00A86B:
Former vice-commander, <Earth Fed Army> Far East.
Laker's right hand, a superb officer. A nervous realist, inflexible at times, but only to cut losses and protect his men.
P_0x00A993:
A mysterious warrior from another world.
His body was lost in a past battle, so he moved his soul into the Roa Armor's crystal. When Kouta wears it, his mind links with Kouta's, offering precise advice.
P_0x00AAF3:
A key member of the <SRX Project>.
A young robotics genius, cheerful and friendly, who grew up admiring robots. Helped build the Grungust series at <Tesla Leicht Institute>, now on <SRX Project>. Also built the Burning PT, loves talking robots with Ryuusei.
